sloka: अनार्य त्वम् कृतघ्नः च मिथ्या वादी च वानर ।पूर्वम् कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत् प्रतिकरोषि यत् ॥४-३४-१३॥
transliteration: anārya tvam kṛtaghnaḥ ca mithyā vādī ca vānara ।pūrvam kṛtārtho rāmasya na tat pratikaroṣi yat ॥4-34-13॥

translations.english: 'O monkey you have already achieved your objective (with the help of Rama) but have not helped Rama in return. You are surely an ignoble and ungrateful liar.
